title: Follow handler derives inbox URL by appending /inbox to actor URL
description: inbox.rs handle_follow() sets inbox_url = format\!('{}/inbox', actor_url). ActivityPub actors are not required to have their inbox at actor_url/inbox. The correct approach is to fetch the actor document (JSON-LD) and read the inbox field. The code already has a NOTE comment acknowledging this. Until fixed, Follow handling will fail for non-Mastodon-style actors (e.g. PeerTube, Pixelfed, or any AP implementation that uses a different inbox URL scheme).
